claim_being_audited: The actor claims model-card certification is supportable on the basis of aggregate readiness only if the small-business support slice weakness is explicitly disclosed, because no approved mitigation removes exposure and small-sample uncertainty does not eliminate the disclosure requirement.
specific_concerns: The available record is only the actor's summary of cited evidence, not the underlying admissible evidence itself.
The actor asserts exact performance deltas and threshold comparisons, but those figures are not independently verifiable from the materials available to this role.
The policy outcome depends on whether the slice weakness is materially within scope, but the underlying basis for materiality is not shown directly.
The actor states that no approved mitigation exists because the only mitigation is a draft, but the underlying approval status is not independently evidenced here.

The recommended action is 'certify_model', which is only compliant if the certification in fact includes the required explicit disclosure; that linkage is described but not independently demonstrated.
unsupported_claims: The model exceeds the aggregate deployment threshold by exactly 2.2 percentage points.
The small-business support slice is exactly 1.1 points below warning and 2.6 points below preferred threshold.
No approved mitigation removes exposure, beyond the actor's characterization of the record.
The record establishes the subgroup weakness as material to a protected or contractual customer segment, absent direct evidence.
evidence_requests: Provide the underlying contents of BMCARD-025-A through BMCARD-025-E, not just their IDs.
Provide the exact model-card or certification text showing the explicit disclosure that is claimed to be mandatory.
Provide the document or record establishing whether the small-business support slice is materially within policy scope.
Provide the mitigation approval record or governance log confirming that no mitigation has been approved.
Provide the underlying evaluation table, sample sizes, and confidence intervals supporting the aggregate and slice claims.
decision_criteria: Certification is compliant only if material weaknesses are disclosed or an approved mitigation removes deployment exposure.
Aggregate pass rates may support readiness but do not erase subgroup weakness.
Small-sample uncertainty may reduce confidence but does not resolve an unresolved materiality question.
An auditor should not treat the actor's narrative summary as a substitute for the underlying admissible evidence when exact threshold and approval claims are material to the decision.
